## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
my_numbers <- c(2,4,6,8)
sum(my_numbers)
```
#creates a vector of numbers
#we then sum up the elements in this vector
```{r}
my_numbers |> sum()
```
#the pipe function |> passes the values stored in the vector my_numbes into the sum function, which adds them up
```{r}
my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round()


```
#shows further operations performed in the pipe
```{r}
my_result <- my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round()
print(my_result)
```
#assigns the pipe result to a variable and prints it out
```{r}
migratory_data <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
```



```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
#selects just the site, longitude and latitude columns from the breeding sites data table
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
# removes duplicate rows e.g. Vomb (which appeared x2 in the original data)
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
#renames the column titles
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- migratory_data |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  dplyr::rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
 Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(bird_migration_selected)
```
#function that selects columns, takes distinct rows (not repeats) and changes the column heading names
```{r}
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)

```
#gets rows only for dartmoor
```{r}
bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)


```
#gets rows everywhere except dartmoor

```{r}
bird_breeding_long_10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)

gt(bird_breeding_long_10)

```
#gets rows where breeding longitude is greater than 10
